name: @supacloud/function-adapter
description: Fetch-based adapters for SupaCloud Edge Functions

scripts.prebuild: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/sveltekit.ts --outfile dist/sveltekit.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/sveltekit-adapter.ts --outfile dist/sveltekit-adapter.js --target bun --format esm && bun x tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
